summary: Retest after switching testimonial avatars from Unsplash to randomuser.me. CONFIRMED FIX: All three testimonial avatars load successfully (naturalWidth=128 for testimonial-0/1/2), zero ORB blocks in network log, zero console errors on home page load. Regression items also verified: hero DNA WebGL canvas renders, FIND MY PEPTIDE (hero-finder-button) opens finder-modal, ship-timer visible, nav CTAs (3) render, testimonials-section renders all 3 cards, top-rated section renders cards.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a highly minified single-file (>100 lines per line). Consider splitting into modules for maintainability; not a blocker.
Testimonial onError handler is defensive and correctly implemented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonial avatar ORB issue is fully resolved by using randomuser.me. Verified: testimonial-0/1/2 img.naturalWidth === 128 (all three), zero net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB requests, zero console errors. Correct testid for FIND MY PEPTIDE button is 'hero-finder-button' (not 'find-my-peptide-btn'). Top-rated cards use testid pattern 'top-rated-{i}' (0..3). Age gate modal appears on first load — must accept via 'YES, I AM 21' text before interacting with hero CTAs.
rca of the issue: Root cause of previous ORB blocks: Unsplash returned responses that Chrome's Opaque Response Blocking (ORB) rejected for cross-origin no-cors image loads (likely due to MIME/nosniff headers). Fix: Switching src to https://randomuser.me/api/portraits/{women|men}/{n}.jpg which serves images with correct image/jpeg content-type and standard headers. Verified via runtime img.naturalWidth (128 for all three, matching source dimensions) and empty requestfailed event log for ORB reasons.
